From reducing plant downtime to controlling maintenance costs, Smart Asset Management delivers measurable results throughout the entire asset lifecycle. Each benefit is the direct result of maintenance that is more connected, more informed, and more closely integrated with production.

According to Gartner, unplanned downtime costs an average of $260,000 per hour in the manufacturing industry. Yet many companies still take a reactive approach to maintenance, stepping in only when something breaks. The result is constant pressure on teams, costs that are difficult to predict, and a direct impact on production continuity.

sedApta Smart Asset Management centralizes maintenance management, correlates plant data with production schedules, and supports the transition from preventive to predictive maintenance. Every project is planned with actual operational priorities in mind, not just standard schedules.

The system correlates plant operational data with maintenance history, maintenance KPIs, and asset performance. Maintenance planners have access to MTBF, MTTR, and system availability metrics without having to aggregate data from different sources. Priorities are derived from data, not from an individual’s subjective experience.
